Transfer to Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)
cohort: The study discusses pregnancy outcomes in reproductive-aged women with Polycystic Ovarian Syndrome (PCOS).
finding: Polycystic Ovarian Syndrome (PCOS) is associated with an elevated risk of various adverse maternal, fetal, and neonatal pregnancy complications, though the precise association remains controversial due to variability in studies.
mod_finding: PCOS is correlated with an increased necessity for cesarean section (CS).
birth_weight: Birth weight variations (large for gestational age [LGA] and small for gestational age [SGA]) are mentioned as outcomes.
gest_age: Prematurity, spontaneous preterm birth (PTB), fetal growth restriction (FGR), large for gestational age (LGA), and small for gestational age (SGA) are mentioned as outcomes related to gestational age.
